subject: Coordination: security exhibit, pen-test window, and evidence cadence for Order Form
messages:
From: Claire Jensen <claire@medicore.com>
To: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medicore.com
Date: 2026-12-20T08:12:00-05:00
Subject: Contract sync: audit rights & evidence cadence

David —

Thanks for taking this. Attaching our latest Order Form with the security exhibit (two attachments: OrderForm_v3_redlines.docx, Security_Exhibit_v2.pdf). A couple of asks from procurement/legal here that we want to resolve in this workback:

- SOC 2 delivery: we need the expected cadence (annual + rolling evidence access). Can you confirm how Redwood will provide the SOC 2 report and whether on-demand evidence snapshots are available?
- Pen test language: the current exhibit requests a 30-day notice window and "forensic access" language. Our security team is asking for clarity on the scope (sampling vs full-system access) and whether pen-tests can be run only in staging.
- Evidence cadence: our auditors expect monthly evidence snapshots for a three-month onboarding period, then quarterly thereafter. Is that operationally realistic?

Can we get a suggested redline from your side focused on bounded inspection language and a realistic evidence cadence? Procurement is targeting DocuSign by 01/10. Appreciate a quick turnaround.

Thanks,
Claire Jensen
Sr. Procurement Manager | Medicore Health
procurement@medicore.com

Attachments: OrderForm_v3_redlines.docx (docx), Security_Exhibit_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>

Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-20T10:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Contract sync: audit rights & evidence cadence

Claire —

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick summary of what we can commit to and what we'll need to tighten in the exhibit/Order Form:

1) SOC 2 report delivery
- We can deliver the full SOC 2 Type II report via a secure share (S3 link + password-protected PDF) and can support an on-demand snapshot export of relevant artifacts for up to 30 days on request.

2) Pen test language and scope
- We cannot provide unfettered live-production forensic access. Proposed compromise: "bounded inspection" with the option to run pen-tests in a staging environment that mirrors production (or in a production-limited scope with a mutually agreed blast radius).
- Proposed notice window: 14 business days for coordinated tests, with an expedited 5-business-day window available for high-priority tests if pre-approved by Redwood security.

3) Evidence cadence
- Operationally we can support the onboarding cadence you described with caveats: monthly snapshots for the first 90 days (as requested) — Redwood will provide exported logs, configuration manifests, and SOC2-annotated artifacts where applicable. After onboarding we recommend quarterly evidence bundles.

Attached I'm adding a marked-up security exhibit that (a) replaces "forensic access" with "bounded inspection and sampling", (b) narrows the scope to defined systems/services and (c) defines the evidence package contents. File: proposed_security_exhibit_redline.docx

Laura (legal) and Kimberly (security) — can you weigh in on the proposed clause text below and the NDAs/third-party pen-test guardrails we should require? If we can align internally by EOD, I can send the redline back to Claire and start an Order Form DocuSign flow.

Next steps
- Internal signoff (Legal + Security) by EOD 12/20
- Send updated exhibit to Medicore 12/20 evening
- Target DocuSign 01/06–01/10 per procurement window

Best,
David Kim
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-20T12:18:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Contract sync: audit rights & evidence cadence

Team —

Reviewing David's proposed language. High level: support the bounded inspection framing, but we need explicit legal guardrails to avoid open-ended obligations. Key items for the MSA/redline:

- Replace any occurrence of "forensic access" or "unfettered access" with: "limited, time-boxed access for the purpose of audit, inspection, or security testing subject to Redwood's security policies and mutually agreed scope (\"Bounded Inspection\")."
- Pen-testers: require Medicore to provide 3rd-party test firm names in advance; require a written Statement of Work and a standard testing NDA (we can provide an NDA template).
- Sampling and scope: define a sampling band (e.g., up to 10% of traffic or specific subsystems) and expressly limit access to non-production/staging unless specifically agreed in writing.
- Evidence requests: provide a capped list of artifact types we will deliver (SOC2 report, logs for specified time windows, configuration manifests); add a reasonable-response SLA (5 business days for standard requests, 10–15 for complex artifact pulls).
- Indemnity and data handling: ensure there's no implied obligation to produce customer PII or de-identified datasets as part of routine evidence unless we have an executed DPA amendment.

I'll attach a short redline for the MSA and a candidate clause for the exhibit (file: legal_redlines_msa.docx). Priyom — can you confirm the commercial fallback if Medicore pushes for a 30-day unfettered production access clause (we should offer an escrow/inspection-lite alternative or an SLA uplift for dedicated capacity)?

If we approve the language internally we should present 2 options back to Medicore: (A) bounded inspection + staging-only pen-tests, monthly onboarding evidence cadence; (B) a limited production test with stricter controls and a one-time fee/SLA uplift. That gives procurement a clear choice.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

David/Laura —

Thanks — that framing is workable. A couple follow-ups to lock the last pieces down before procurement moves to signature:

1) Pen-test window dates: Medicore security prefers Jan 18–22 for the initial verification window. Can Redwood confirm staging availability during that window (we can be flexible within that week)?
2) NDA/third-party testers: we will share the vendor list by 12/22 and accept your NDA template.
3) SOC 2 delivery: confirm you will upload the Type II report to the secure share and also grant a one-time export of onboarding artifacts for our auditor. Our team will need the S3 link + password by 01/04.

If Redwood can confirm the above, procurement will route the Order Form for signature next week. Please counter with the updated exhibit and the two-option approach Laura suggested so we can make a commercial decision.

Appreciate the quick coordination — looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

Claire Jensen
